info.name: TKD Tournament API
info.description:
Postman collection for the Meedan TKD Tournament Management System

Base URL: {{base_url}}
Auth: Bearer token via {{auth_token}}

Documented Endpoints:
- Auth: POST /auth/register, POST /auth/login
- Tournaments: GET/POST /tournaments, GET/PUT/DELETE /tournaments/:id
- Categories: GET /categories/:categoryId
- Players: GET/POST /players
- Clubs: GET/POST /clubs
- Matches: GET /matches, POST /matches/generate (single category), POST /matches/tournament/:id/generate-brackets (bulk)
- Live Matches: GET /matches/:matchId/live, POST /matches/:matchId/live/action|points|points/undo|penalty|injury|exclude, GET /matches/:matchId/suggestions

Bracket Generation:
- Brackets are auto-generated when a tournament is created (empty if no players registered yet)
- POST /matches/generate: Generate bracket for one weight class (HEAD_JUDGE auth)
- POST /matches/tournament/:id/generate-brackets: Generate brackets for ALL categories (admin auth)
- Round convention: 1=Final, 2=Semi-Final, 3=Quarter-Final, etc.
- Player count trimmed to nearest power of 2 (floor) — no BYEs
